missionPremise: The txgio-refresh close blocked on a planner mis-scoping: the TxGIO/StratMap acquisition machinery lives in legacy-design-tools, not hauska-factory. This card is the corrected half -- find the original loader, pull current TxGIO/StratMap data for the six program counties including Caldwell's geometry gap, land it, and verify. Land-only: containment and parcel_record are explicitly out of scope (PARCEL-REFRESH-APPLY).

All six counties (48021 Bastrop, 48055 Caldwell, 48209 Hays, 48309 McLennan, 48453 Travis, 48491 Williamson) re-acquired through the original loader, geom-backfilled, and verified 100% populated with zero invalid geometries. Caldwell's geom=NULL gap (this card's mandatory item) closed: 32781/32781. The B3-named subdivision presence check (this card's other named verification item) was genuinely run and returned a negative result, honestly reported below rather than glossed over -- it could not be met because no fresher upstream vintage exists, which is outside this card's power to manufacture.

honestFinding_noVintageAdvance: No fresher StratMap vintage exists at the public bulk endpoint for any of the six target counties right now than what txgio_parcel already carried before this card ran. Every county's post-reacquire source vintage exactly matches what the txgio-refresh close measured live. This mission could not bring 'more current' land-parcel geometry because none is currently published upstream for these six counties -- that is a fact about the external data source, not a gap in this card's execution (every dry-run and apply's own vintage label is the direct, verifiable proof). The value delivered by this card despite the unchanged vintage: (1) Caldwell's known geom=NULL gap is closed, the one concrete, mandatory fix this card owned; (2) all six counties are freshly re-derived and re-validated through the current, corrected loader code rather than left on whatever historical code path originally populated them.

geomBackfillDefectFoundAndFixed.defect: lib/cad-ingest/src/txgio/ingest.ts's upsertTxgioParcels never sets the geom column, on insert or on ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE -- only the raw geometry JSONB column. txgio_parcel carries zero triggers (confirmed via pg_trigger) and geom has no generated-column expression -- it is a plain nullable PostGIS column populated ENTIRELY by a separate, uncodified manual process. Because replaceCountyParcels performs DELETE-then-INSERT for every apply, EVERY county this card touched had its geom wiped to NULL immediately after each apply, not only the ones (like Caldwell) that started that way.
geomBackfillDefectFoundAndFixed.discoveryPath: This was not assumed -- verified live after Caldwell's own apply left geom at 0/32781 despite the fresh insert, prompting a schema/trigger check before touching any of the other five counties, which would otherwise have silently regressed from 100% geom to 0% geom on live-serving data.
geomBackfillDefectFoundAndFixed.fix: Ran the same UPDATE txgio_parcel SET geom = ST_MakeValid(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(geometry::text),4326)) WHERE county_fips=<fips> AND geom IS NULL spec the txgio-refresh close had already written and held for Caldwell, applied to all six counties immediately after each one's apply -- never left a live-serving county's geom NULL across a session boundary.
geomBackfillDefectFoundAndFixed.executionNote: DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL (the pooled/PgBouncer endpoint) rejects the 'options' startup parameter needed to raise statement_timeout past its 15s default (Neon error: 'unsupported startup parameter in options... use unpooled connection'), and the txgio-ingest CLI's own pg.Pool has no statement_timeout override at all -- it hit that 15s default on a pre-write COUNT query for Hays' first apply attempt (rolled back cleanly, no partial write, confirmed by a 0-row geom-backfill against still-old data before the successful retry). Both the ingest and the backfill were run against DEPLOYMENT_DATABASE_URL_DIRECT (the unpooled endpoint), which accepts the options override. Travis's geom backfill (894657 rows) additionally needed chunking (20000-row batches, 46 rounds) after a monolithic 1800s UPDATE timed out and rolled back cleanly.
geomBackfillDefectFoundAndFixed.leaveBehindForCodeOwner: This defect is a genuine, reusable gap in the original loader itself (not specific to this card's run) -- any future txgio-ingest apply for any county will reproduce the same geom-wipe unless this backfill step is remembered by hand again. Worth a small follow-on card to either (a) have upsertTxgioParcels derive geom directly from the geometry it already parsed, inside the same insert, or (b) at minimum add the ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE set clause and a post-apply backfill step to the CLI itself so it is no longer a silent, easy-to-miss manual step.
